test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Insatiable
solution:
The correct answer is** fulfilled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Insatiable: **that cannot be satisfied; very great. जिसे तृप्‍त न किया जा सके, अतृप्‍त; अपरितोष्‍य, अत्‍यधिक
 
• **Fulfilled: **feeling happy and satisfied. प्रसन्‍न व संतुष्‍ट
 
• Thus, the most appropriate antonym of **insatiable** is** fulfilled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urgent: **needing immediate attention. जिस पर तुरंत ध्यान देना अपेक्षित है, तुरंत कार्रवाई की अपेक्षा वाला; अत्‍यावश्‍यक, बहुत ज़रूरी
 
• **Greedy: **wanting more food, money, power, etc. than you really need.अपनी वास्तविक आवश्यकता से अधिक भोजन, पैसों आदि की कामना करनेवाला व्यक्ति; लोभी, लालची
 
• **Insistent: **continuing for a long time in a way that cannot be ignored. देर तक चलने वाला (अतएव अनुपेक्षणीय)

3a:T824,

The correct answer is **glowing**.
